iut_type: End Product incorporating Q309899 Core-Controller SoC (Move company)
customer_question: Does the 'person in charge' (担当者) referenced in the quote request need to be the company's SIG account signer?
question_variants: Is the registration point-of-contact required to be the same person as our SIG member signer?
actual_issue: Move company (Koji Kishimoto) asked whether the contact person listed on the quote request form had to be the same individual designated as their company's Bluetooth SIG member account signer.
plain_english_explanation: The 'person in charge' field is just the point of contact for the registration process — it does not need to be the same person who is registered as the company's SIG account signer.
consultant_answer: The person in charge is simply the registration point of contact and does not need to be your company's member-registration signer.
decision_logic: SIG account signer authority and day-to-day registration point of contact are separate roles; the quote/registration process only requires a contact person, not signer-level authority.
final_recommendation: Clarify this distinction proactively in quote request instructions to avoid customer confusion about who needs to fill out the contact field.
risk_if_done_wrong: None significant — a misunderstanding here would only cause a minor delay in form completion, not a compliance issue.
